1.w: Channels of water [is] the heart of a king in the hand of YHWH; upon all that He wishes, He stretches it out.

2.w: Every way of a man [is] right in his own eyes, and YHWH is measuring hearts.

3.w: To do righteousness and justice is chosen of YHWH above sacrifice.

4.w: Loftiness of eyes and broadness of heart—the guides of the wicked—[are] sin.

5.w: The plans of the diligent [are] surely to abundance, and everyone hurrying about, surely to poverty.

6.w: Working [for] treasures by a tongue of deception is a vapor driven away [of those] seeking death.

7.w: The violence of the wicked will drag them away, for they refuse to do justice.

8.w: The way of a guilty man [is] crooked, and [for] a pure one, his work [is] straight.

9.w: Better to sit on the corner of a roof, than with a woman of quarrels and a house of company.

10.w: The soul of a wicked one desires evil; his neighbor shall not find favor in his eyes.

11.w: By fining a mocker, a simple one is made wise; and in giving understanding to a wise one, he receives knowledge.

12.w: The Righteous One considers the house of the wicked, overthrowing the wicked for wickedness.

13.w: One shutting his ears to the cry of the poor, he also will cry out, and will not be answered.

14.w: A gift in secret subdues anger, and a bribe in the bosom, strong rage.

15.w: A joy for the righteous is doing justice, and a terror for the workers of iniquity.

16.w: A man wandering from the way of understanding will come to rest in the assembly of Rephaim.

17.w: The one loving pleasure [is] a man of need, the one loving wine and oil will not become rich.

18.w: A wicked one [is] a ransom for a righteous one, and the one acting treacherously for upright ones.

19.w: Better to dwell in a land of wilderness than with a woman of quarrels and provocation.

20.w: Treasure to be desired and oil [are] in the dwelling of a wise one, and a foolish man swallows it up.

21.w: One pursuing righteousness and loving devotion will find life, righteousness, and honor.

22.w: A wise one ascends a city of mighty ones, and he brings down the stronghold of its confidence.

23.w: The one guarding his mouth and his tongue is guarding his soul from distress.

24.w: The arrogant [and] haughty one—Mocker [is] his name—he is acting in the outpouring of pride.

25.w: The desire of the lazy one brings him death, for his hands refuse to work.

26.w: All the day he has desired [his] desire and the righteous one gives and does not withhold.

27.w: The sacrifice of wicked ones [is] an abomination—how much more when he brings it in wickedness!

28.w: A witness of falsehood will perish, and the man being attentive will speak forever.

29.w: A wicked man strengthens his face, and an upright one—he establishes his way.

30.w: There is no wisdom and no understanding and no counsel against YHWH.

31.w: The horse [is] prepared for the day of battle, and the victory [is] of YHWH.
